items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: So when they found that out man, they opened those doors so Tommy Ladnier and I could get down in that pit.

ctx.x: In the pit. And Mike ( VASSO ?) he was so nice to us you know. And a trumpet player by the name of MERVE ? Steinberg he was nice to us. Because at one time before the first show, after the pit band went in, then they had the doors all locked. And Joe Jordan was the delegate that, So Joe Jordan said, well if they don't open those doors down there, he say, you all come out and jump from the stage to the pit, see. And I think it was Whiteman was the manager of the theater, the Paramount Theater.
So when they found that out man, they opened those doors so Tommy Ladnier and I could get down in that pit. It seemed that they had to bring the pit down again for us to go back in there.
Yes. You'd known I take it, you'd Tommy Ladnier a long time?
